name: Flan-chan to Issho!
original_name: フランちゃんといっしょ!
source:
After straying into Gensokyo, you get to spend love-filled days with Flan-chan! You also get to make love to Koishi-chan and Nue-chan!

(Translated author's comment on [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=33254&adult_view=1/]Melonbooks[/url])
translation:
误入幻想乡后，与芙兰酱一起度过充满爱的日子！还可以和恋酱和女酱做爱！

（翻译作者对 [url=https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=33254&adult_view=1/]Melonbooks[/url] 的评论）
